turns.content: A particle of mass m moves in the three-dimensional isotropic potential V(r)=(1/2)m omega^2 r^2. Identify the quantum system and write its energy in terms of the total oscillator quantum number N.
For the third excited shell, determine N and use the spectrum just obtained to calculate its energy.
Count the linearly independent eigenfunctions in that shell by enumerating nonnegative Cartesian triples (n_x,n_y,n_z) with sum N.
Verify the full-shell degeneracy with the general formula for the number of nonnegative integer triples summing to N.
Cross-check the count using the allowed angular-momentum sectors. Why would counting only one value of l undercount the energy eigenspace?
Report the third-excited-shell energy and the number of linearly independent eigenfunctions at that energy.
